summary: Post-nuclear RPG series from Interplay, Black Isle, Obsidian, and Bethesda; primary picks favor complete PC editions where available, with console-only spin-offs preserved on their original hardware routes.

entries.title: Fallout

emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Windows native / DOSBox for historical DOS

primary.why: Fallout shipped on MS-DOS, Windows, Mac OS, and Mac OS X; Windows remains the most practical modern route with current storefront availability and compatibility fixes.
primary.how_to_play: Play the current Windows release from GOG, Steam, or Epic; apply community compatibility fixes only as needed and preserve the original executable/data.

entries.remaster_caveats: Use the original game release, not a remake; apply compatibility fixes only as needed.

entries.title: Fallout 2

primary.why: Fallout 2 shipped on Windows and Mac OS X; Windows is the most practical current route and avoids the Mac PowerPC compatibility caveat.
primary.how_to_play: Play the current Windows release from GOG, Steam, or Epic; use compatibility fixes only as needed.

entries.remaster_caveats: Use the original game release, not a remake; apply compatibility fixes only as needed.

primary.why: Fallout Tactics shipped for Windows only, making the current PC release the preservation route.
primary.how_to_play: Play the current Windows release from GOG, Steam, or Epic with compatibility settings as needed.

entries.title: Fallout: Brotherhood of Steel

emulation.notes: Original Xbox hardware remains the baseline; PS2 route can use PCSX2 if that copy is owned.

primary.why: Fallout: Brotherhood of Steel is console-only on PlayStation 2 and Xbox; the Xbox release is the preferred console preservation target here.
primary.how_to_play: Play an owned Xbox copy on original hardware or a verified Xbox emulation setup; use the PS2 version only if that is the preserved copy.

entries.remaster_caveats: Console-only spin-off; not the same game as Fallout Tactics despite the similar Brotherhood wording.

entries.title: Fallout 3
entries.definitive_edition: Fallout 3: Game of the Year Edition

primary.why: The PC Game of the Year Edition includes all five add-on packs and gives the best mod/fix path for this 2008 open-world entry.
primary.how_to_play: Play Fallout 3: Game of the Year Edition on Windows via Steam, GOG, or Epic with modern compatibility fixes as needed.

entries.remaster_caveats: Use GOTY for all add-ons; apply only compatibility/stability fixes needed for modern Windows.

entries.title: Fallout: New Vegas

primary.why: The Windows Ultimate Edition bundles the base game with its DLC and gives the best mod/fix path for stability and preservation.
primary.how_to_play: Play Fallout: New Vegas Ultimate on Windows via Steam, GOG, or Epic; use stability/fix mods as needed and document the load order.

entries.remaster_caveats: Use Ultimate for all DLC; apply only compatibility/stability fixes needed for modern Windows.

entries.title: Fallout Shelter

primary.why: Fallout Shelter is available across mobile, PC, and consoles; Windows is the easiest archive/capture route while preserving the current single-player management game.
primary.how_to_play: Play the current Windows/Steam or Bethesda PC version, noting the build because seasonal updates can alter content.

entries.remaster_caveats: Current-update state matters; seasonal content may change.

entries.title: Fallout Shelter Online

emulation.notes: Prefer native Android device if available.

primary.why: Fallout Shelter Online is a mobile sequel/evolution released for iOS and Android in Asian territories; Android is the practical preservation target for current availability.
primary.how_to_play: Play the current Android release if available in your region; document region, server, and build because online/mobile availability can change.

entries.remaster_caveats: Online/mobile regional title; document server and build.

entries.title: Fallout 4

primary.why: Fallout 4: Anniversary Edition includes the base game, six official expansions, and more than 150 Creation Club items; Windows adds the strongest mod/fix and capture route.
primary.how_to_play: Play Fallout 4: Anniversary Edition on Windows, documenting Creation/mod load order and the exact update version.

entries.remaster_caveats: Creation/mod content can change; document update version and load order.

entries.title: Fallout 4 VR

primary.why: Fallout 4 VR is a standalone Windows VR version and does not include the original game's DLC, so it is a VR side-route rather than the definitive Fallout 4 playthrough.
primary.how_to_play: Play on Windows through SteamVR with a compatible headset; use Fallout 4 Anniversary Edition for the complete non-VR run.

entries.remaster_caveats: Use only for VR experience; play Fallout 4 Anniversary Edition for the complete content package.

entries.title: Fallout 76

primary.why: Fallout 76 is an online Fallout entry on Windows, PlayStation 4, and Xbox One; Windows is the best current archive/capture route for the live client.
primary.how_to_play: Play the current Windows client via Steam, Microsoft Store, or Bethesda-supported launcher path; document season, patch, and server state.

entries.remaster_caveats: Document season, patch, and server state; revisit when PS5/Xbox Series native versions ship.
